proof_body:
by
  intro a b n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ (fun k => a k * b k) (n + 1), ih,
      Finset.sum_range_succ (fun k => (a (k + 1) - a k) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), b i) n,
      Finset.sum_range_succ b (n + 1)]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k * b k = a n * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), b i) - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (a (k + 1) - a k) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), b i
